title: Suspense and SSR hydration
objective: Prefetch safe public data in a Next.js Server Component, dehydrate it, and hydrate the same query key on the client.
predict: The first client render uses the prefetched cache; a later refetch occurs only when freshness policy requires it.
expectedBehavior: In a real Next.js app, compare server and client query keys exactly. Inspect dehydrated state and verify only safe anonymous data appears; test hydration with a mounted QueryClientProvider.
commonFailure: The starter creates QueryClient but fails to prefetch and hydrate into the client component with a matching key.
securityBoundary: Never dehydrate authentication tokens, internal service responses, another user's tasks or secrets into a public HTML payload. This server-only example is not a Vite browser route.
